response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing, my friends. Something's missing.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER JACK, approaches the king.

JESTER JACK
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I don't know, Jack. I just feel like our kingdom's aesthetic is, well, a bit...stale.

JESTER JACK
(stunned)
Stale, Your Majesty? But our kingdom is the epitome of grandeur!

KING REGINALD
(sighing)
I know, I know. But think about it, Jack. Our flags are too bold, our armor is too shiny, and our castles are too...castellated. We need something new, something fresh.

JESTER JACK
(curious)
Something like what, Your Majesty?

KING REGINALD
(excited)
I don't know, but I have a feeling it's going to be...vaporwave.

JESTER JACK
(confused)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty? But that's a...a...a music genre!

KING REGINALD
(determined)
Exactly! And I'm going to make it happen. I'm going to turn our entire kingdom into a proto-vaporwave empire.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his advisors, including LORD THOMAS and LADY ISABELLA. They look on in confusion as the king begins to explain his vision.

KING REGINALD
We're going to start by replacing our traditional coats of arms with...with... (consults a parchment)...with "glitch art" emblems. And our armor will be replaced with...with... (gestures to a nearby servant)...with neon-colored, PVC-piped breastplates.

LORD THOMAS
(skeptical)
But, Your Majesty, what about our traditional heraldry?

KING REGINALD
(waving his hand)
Pfft, heraldry is so...last season. We're going for something more...more... ( searches for the right word)...more "futuristic".

LADY ISABELLA
(sarcastically)
Oh, joy. Because nothing says "futuristic" like a bunch of knights in neon-colored armor.

KING REGINALD
(laughing)
Ah, come on, Isabella! You have to admit, it's going to be... (consults a nearby scribe)...it's going to be "totally tubular"!

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The flags are now glitchy, pixelated, and feature a lot of 8-bit graphics. The armor is neon-colored and PVC-piped, and the castles are now shaped like...like... (consults a nearby scribe)...like "vaporwave castles".

KING REGINALD
(proudly)
Behold, my friends! Our kingdom is now a proto-vaporwave empire!

JESTER JACK
(amazed)
Wow, Your Majesty. You've really outdone yourself.

KING REGINALD
(smiling)
I know, right? I'm like... (consults a nearby scribe)...I'm like the "Vaporwave King"!

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is sitting on his throne, surrounded by his advisors. He's wearing a pair of...of... (consults a nearby scribe)...of "futuristic" glasses.

KING REGINALD
(to his advisors)
Now, let's get down to business. We need to...we need to... (consults a nearby scribe)...we need to "rebrand" our entire kingdom.

LORD THOMAS
(confused)
Rebrand, Your Majesty? But what do you mean?

KING REGINALD
(excited)
I mean, we need to make our kingdom sound...sound... (consults a nearby scribe)...sound "vaporwave".

LADY ISABELLA
(sarcastically)
Oh, joy. Because nothing says "vaporwave" like a bunch of knights in neon-colored armor.

KING REGINALD
(laughing)
Ah, come on, Isabella! You have to admit, it's going to be... (consults a nearby scribe)...it's going to be "totally rad"!

FADE OUT.
